l.i: Ita reddiderunt mihi malum pro Bono, &
odium pro dilectione mea.
Sis mihi (Domine) Gubernator in tenebrosa
hac nimis & ancipiti procella, in qua nec remea-
rcad[?] Portum datur unde solverim, nec incolumem
ut volui, & famâ integrâ ad alium contendere.
T-
u me facile tutum custodies in amore & fidu-
cia Populi mei, Tu me Saluum præstabis inter
odia injusta, & suspiciones multorum, quas eo
hactenus invalescere in me permisisti ut maximas
quas unquam indulsi Gratias cum fiducia de illis
summâ conjunctas, corrumpant omnes & in me
abutantur.
Nullæ vero à me collatæ Gratiæ magis un-
quam in abutentium crimen cedent, quam illæ
Tuæ in me Domine crebræ & ingentes, quibus me
turpiter abusum agnosco.
Des mihi & illis (precor) eam pœnitentiam
qualem tu accepturus es, & eam Gratiam infu-
per quâ non abutamur: Eâ saltem me becs[?] (Do-
mine) ut rectè utar aliorum injuriis, & per eo-
rum in me delictâ, meas rursum in Te offensiones
cum dolore Reformante intuear.
Ita quanquam temporalibus in tuis beneficiis
per aliorum quidem peccata, sed propter mea des-
tituar, fœlix tamen fruar misericordiarum tua-
rum Solatiis, per quæ gravissima perpessi in
sanctorum Gloriam assurgunt.

page.notes: The page number "50" is printed in the Greek-style header at the top left and is read as 50 from the scan. The large "6. De" at the bottom right is treated as a catchword "De"; the "6." may be a signature or the start of the next page's heading, and is not transcribed. "remea-rcad" at the line end is doubtful: the hyphenated word and the following "rcad" may be a printing or scan error. "becs" is doubtful. "Reformante intuear" reads as printed. Body text appears to be set in italic throughout.
